latestVersion.changelog:
cp2k-input-generator v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Generates accurate CP2K input files (.inp) for quantum chemistry calculations based on user specifications and structure files (cif, pdb, xyz, etc.).
- Supports multiple calculation types: energy, geometry optimization, molecular dynamics, frequency analysis, NEB, and more.
- Handles various computational methods: DFT (Quickstep), QMMM, MM, and xTB.
- Automatically selects suitable parameters (basis set, CUTOFF, k-points, etc.) according to system size and user needs.
- Includes comprehensive input validation, examples, and troubleshooting tips for common CP2K input issues.
